ruleset.name: mailkube-java-examples
ruleset.description:
Examples keep the complexity, dead-code and correctness rules. They drop the documentation one: a JEP 512 compact source file declares no public type, and each example carries a prose header explaining what it does and how to run it — that IS its documentation.
Two traps, both of which produce a GREEN build while checking nothing:
1. A ruleset that fails to load does not fail the build. PMD prints "Cannot load ruleset", then "No files to analyze", and Gradle reports success. Rules are restated here rather than `ref`-ing ruleset.xml because PMD resolves a `ref` against the CLASSPATH, not against this file — see ruleset-test.xml, where all three spellings were tried. 2. PMD 7.26.0 cannot parse a TOP-LEVEL FIELD in a compact source file. It logs a ParseException, skips the file, and still exits 0. Keep every field inside `main`, and note that CI greps the pmdExamples output for "ParseException" precisely because the task cannot be trusted to fail on its own.
